rationale: The morning spike to 34.31 was fully absorbed by sellers, but the tape has since gone dead — five candles in a ~15-cent band on evaporating volume, pinned to the 9-EMA at 32.73, with no news catalyst and momentum in neither direction. A short on the faded gap would be chasing a move that already happened (and borrowing terms on an unknown-cap name are unverifiable), while a long has no supporting structure below the rolling VWAP regime. With volatility collapsed and evidence two-sided, there is no mechanical edge to justify either entry with 70 minutes left.
